top_offers.title: Product Engineer
top_offers.why: Langfuse builds the leading open-source LLM engineering platform (tracing, evals, prompt management) on a TypeScript T3 stack that overlaps heavily with Magino's core skills, and the YC-backed seed-stage setup mirrors the founding-engineer ownership he had at Alaya. It's remote-first for Europe with only monthly Berlin travel, so it works from Geneva, and the AI-native product is a direct match for his AI-augmented engineering focus.

top_offers.title: Applied AI Engineer
top_offers.why: DeepJudge is a Zurich AI scale-up founded by ex-Google/ETH researchers building precision AI search for legal teams, squarely in the AI-first, product-led company profile Magino targets post-Benevity. It's Switzerland-based and fast-growing, though the posting doesn't spell out seniority, so it's worth confirming the scope lands at Staff-equivalent before applying.

top_offers.title: Founding Backend Engineer
top_offers.why: A genuine founding-engineer seat with 2-3% equity at a Swiss early-stage startup, the closest match to the zero-to-one ownership Magino had building Alaya. It's an unproven, pre-scale company with limited public information on mission or funding, which keeps it a notch below the top two despite the seniority and location fit.
